notes: 14 searches used. Review: (1) Children: NHS pages conflict (specialist from age 6 vs nasal spray from 12); Migraine Trust says nasal spray the only triptan licensed over 12; check SmPC. (2) Breastfeeding: NHS overview says wait 12 hours; pregnancy page says OK if baby healthy; nhsinform page uses the word 'safe' (do not copy). (3) Pregnancy: who-can page lists as caution while pregnancy page is reassuring. (4) Regulatory: injection legal status not confirmed; nasal spray POM per SmPC; Devon formulary says readily OTC (tablets). (5) Serotonin syndrome: NHS advises 999 for severe symptoms; consider adding. (6) Torbay leaflet is a 2018 local trust leaflet; Migraine Trust gives same aura advice. (7) Several NHS statements seen only through search summaries; page dates may vary (Common questions reviewed Dec 2022). | Editorial tidy-ups after the second pass (duplicate sentences removed or one wording softened) are marked in the claims where they apply. Replacement sentences came from the second-pass retrieval and were not run through a third check.
